name: Plasma Physics from First Principles

phase_0.boundary_condition: Debye sphere — the natural screening length beyond which charge neutrality is enforced

VINIT.justification: The pre-plasma state: un-ionized atoms or molecules with no collective electromagnetic behavior, void of charge separation

TANCH.justification: The closed boundary of electrostatic influence; within one Debye length, charge imbalances are felt, outside they are screened, defining the system’s containment

AFWD.justification: The forward morphism from neutral gas to ionized plasma: energy input (electric field, heating) transforms atoms into free electrons and ions

AREV.justification: A reverse/descent transformation where electromagnetic wave energy is transferred resonantly to ions, converting organized motion into thermal motion

CLINK.justification: Compositional chaining: electron Langmuir oscillations couple to ion motion, producing ion-acoustic waves and bridging electrostatic and inertial regimes

IMSCRIB.justification: Self-reference: the plasma generates fields that determine particle motion, which in turn generates those same fields; the system’s identity is its own field-particle loop

FSPLIT.chosen_element: decomposition into electrostatic and electromagnetic collective modes
FSPLIT.justification: The complete plasma linear response splits into longitudinal (Langmuir, electrostatic) and transverse (Alfvén, electromagnetic) branches, corresponding to distinct physical excitations

FFUSE.justification: The electrostatic and electromagnetic responses are combined via the full dielectric tensor ε(ω,k), recovering the complete wave spectrum of the Vlasov-Maxwell system — the original self-consistent state is reconstituted

EVALT.justification: The affirmative branch: electrostatic collective mode that persists without growth or damping, a success state of coherent electron motion

EVALF.justification: The negative branch: magnetic fluctuations that surpass stability thresholds (e.g., firehose, kink), leading to disruptive loss of confinement

ENGAGR.justification: A paradice: wave energy dissipates without binary collisions — simultaneously a collective (wave) and a kinetic (resonant particle) process, held in unresolved dual description

IFIX.justification: In ideal MHD, Alfvén’s theorem makes the magnetic field topology an irreversible record of the plasma’s flow, permanently imprinted in the fluid elements

phase_2.split_element: decomposition into electrostatic and electromagnetic collective modes
phase_2.split_input: complete Vlasov-Maxwell linear wave spectrum (all collective modes)
phase_2.fuse_result: complete Vlasov-Maxwell linear wave spectrum (the original, self-consistent mode structure)

phase_3.void_description: neutral gas — no charge separation, no collective fields, no ionization
phase_3.true_description: stable confined plasma — well-contained, laminar in MHD, no disruptive instabilities
phase_3.false_description: disrupted plasma — loss of confinement, major instability (e.g., tokamak disruption)
phase_3.both_description: collisionless plasma exhibiting collective fluid-like behavior without local thermodynamic equilibrium — a state of simultaneous particle and wave character

steps.domain_action: neutral gas at thermal equilibrium, no ionization or collective effects — the plasma does not yet exist
ionization — energy input drives the gas into a plasma state, creating free electrons and ions
Debye sphere forms as the electrostatic screening boundary, enclosing the region where charge fluctuations are felt
self-consistent fields develop — particle currents generate electromagnetic fields that react back on the particles, closing the identity loop
the collective plasma response is decomposed into electrostatic (longitudinal) and electromagnetic (transverse) branches
stable Langmuir oscillation — an electrostatic collective mode, the affirmative/success state of coherent electron motion
electron-ion hybrid coupling — Langmuir oscillations interact with ion inertia, producing ion-acoustic waves via compositional chaining
ion-cyclotron damping — in the electromagnetic branch, wave energy is resonantly transferred to ions, reversing from organized wave to random thermal motion
Alfvénic instability onset — if the magnetic perturbation exceeds the stability threshold, the Alfvén wave becomes unstable, triggering the negative/failure state
collisionless Landau damping — wave energy dissipates without collisions, a paradice holding both wave-like collective behavior and resonant particle interactions simultaneously
the dielectric tensor ε(ω,k) unifies the electrostatic and electromagnetic responses, reconstructing the complete linear wave spectrum and returning to the full Vlasov-Maxwell system
ideal MHD freezes the magnetic field into the plasma, permanently recording the flow topology as an irreversible imprinted structure

phase_5.compiler_frontend: Vlasov-Maxwell solver (e.g., particle-in-cell code) — translates the continuous distribution and field equations into discrete computational steps
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: self-consistent field coupling — charge and current densities computed from the particle distribution provide sources for Maxwell’s equations, and the resulting Lorentz force feeds back into the Vlasov equation
phase_5.memory_mechanism: particle phase space — the distribution function f(x,v) stores the state of all charged particles; field values are stored in space-time grids
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: time-stepping algorithm (e.g., leapfrog or Crank-Nicolson) — determines the sequential advance of particle and field states while preserving symplectic structure
phase_5.alfs_store: Boltzmann equation / neutral gas ensemble — the canonical bootstrap store from which the plasma is born through ionization

phase_6.cycle_cost: no energy is dissipated in the collisionless Vlasov-Maxwell cycle; the only cost is the computational effort of solving the equations
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: coherent collective modes prior to any collisional or dissipative process
phase_6.post_cycle_state: the same collective mode structure after one closed loop (electrostatic + electromagnetic → unified → split again) — no net entropy increase
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — collisionless plasma dynamics preserve phase-space entropy; the cycle is reversible and non-dissipative, consistent with the Frobenius closure
